classes.name: layout-controls
classes.treatment: Tab/LF/CR are layout controls, not independent visible glyph requirements; the consumer must validate their actual layout treatment.

classes.name: bidi-controls
classes.treatment: No independent visible glyph is normally required; direction and source-order semantics need a separate check.

classes.name: shaping-controls
classes.treatment: CGJ/ZWNJ/ZWJ affect sequences; scalar cmap coverage does not prove correct shaping or justify dropping the controls.

classes.name: zero-width-break-controls
classes.treatment: Not independent visible ink; line-breaking and BOM/context semantics remain consumer decisions.

classes.name: variation-selectors
classes.treatment: No variation-sequence coverage is asserted. These fonts have no cmap format 14; validate base/selector sequences separately.

classes.name: soft-hyphen
classes.treatment: Conditionally visible at a line break; do not exempt it without checking the visible hyphen and line-breaking policy.
